fixed_inputs.cutoffs_source: seed-42 validation period (4C-3B); not re-tuned on hold-out data; not probabilities
fixed_inputs.primary_population: transactions with at least 10 earlier transactions of the same customer

bootstrap.unit: customer component (ring victims and households kept together), resampled within each dataset

shared_device_rule.note: the live rule (a device used by 2+ customers); it is the same for every model set

decision_rule.population: primary (at least 10 earlier transactions), all hold-out datasets pooled

recall_at_least_matches.test: lower bound of the 95% interval of the recall difference > -0.05

alert_burden_at_least_matches.test: upper bound of the 95% interval of the legitimate-alert difference < +1.0 per 1,000

critical_tier_not_worse.test: lower bound of the 95% interval of the Critical-tier recall difference > -0.05

against_production.rule: legitimate alerts per 1,000: upper bound <= 10.0; recall >= 0.4; lower bound of the recall interval above production's point estimate

decision_rule.multiplicity_note: three primary endpoints and three pairs of model sets give nine primary comparisons; about one in twenty such 95% intervals excludes zero by chance
decision_rule.promotion: none. This rule reports evidence only; MODEL_SET stays production.

new_customer_fraud.note: fraud with fewer than 10 earlier transactions is not represented in these datasets; it needs the generator extension and is evaluated separately
